tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gnyan mgon zhal bzhi pa'i gtor bsngos dang bsnyen sgrub bzhugs so//

bla ma dang 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dbang thob cing dam la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po la gtor ma 'bul zhing bsnyen par 'dod pas 'byor na rdo nag gi maṇḍal sogs lag len mthong rgyun ltar/ ma 'byor na gtor ma gtso 'khor lnga pa lag len ltar bcas pa'i mdun du/ khrag chang gi mchod pa dang nang mchod sogs bshams/ mchod pa dang nang mchod bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa/ nang mchod sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i ngo bo gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun du dur khrod kyi bkod pa 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus su paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma/ de'i steng du ro'i gdan la/ hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las| lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po/ sku mdog dang rtsa zhal char sprin nag po ltar gnag cing 'bar ba/ zhal lhag ma g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha khro zhing gtum pa/ spyan gsum gsum dang mche ba gtsigs shing ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ gi nga ro sgrog pa/ phyag dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag /'og ma gnyis ral gri dang mi rus kyi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang sbrul dang dar dpyangs kyis bklubs pa/ ral pa dang smin ma dmar ser dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba/ de'i g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du gtum mo ljang gu/ mdun du srin mo dmar nag /rgyab tu siṅga lī ma ser nag /bzhi ka'ang gri thod 'dzin cing gcer mo khro gtum mi sdug pa'i rnam 'gyur can/ dor stabs kyis gtso bo la phyogs pas gnas pa/ sde brgyad kyi bshan pa mtha' yas pas bskor bar gyur/ mgon po'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis 'og min gyi gnas dang ti se'i gangs/

bsil ba'i tshal| dar lung gnyan gyi pho brang la sogs pa nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ pheṃ/ hūm̐ */ gdod nas dag pa chos sku'i rang bzhin la// snying rjes khros pa lha chen stobs 'phrog che// yum chen 'jigs gzugs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren bzhugs shing phrin las mdzod// oṃ ma hā kā lā kā lā/ bi kā la/ rā tri ta/ ḍoṃ bhi nī/ tsaṇḍa lī rākṣa sī/ siṅga lī de wī sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ ma hā kā lā kā lā/ bi kā la/ rā tri ta/ ḍoṃ bhi nī/ tsaṇḍa lī/ rākṣa sī/ siṅga lī de wī sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya sma rā ya sa ma ya ma ti kra ma yaṃ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ khyab bdag rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa ji bzhin du rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las 'grub par mdzod cig /gong gi sngags mthar/ arghaṃ nas shapada'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ gong gi wā ra'i mthar i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bdun sogs kyis gtor ma phul la/ hūm̐ */ srin po'i gzugs 'chang sems dpa' che// ma rungs gdug pa tshar gcod cing*// phrin las sgrub la thogs med pa// stobs 'phrog drag po khyod la bstod// yum chen 'jigs gzugs sring mo bzhi// gar mdzad gad rgyangs stong gsum g.yo// dgra bgegs rlog cing gzhom mdzad pa| |'khor dang bcas la bstod par bgyi// mgon po'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ gi mthar rang sngags dang*/ yum bzhi'i thugs kar ḍoṃ tsaṃ raṃ siṃ rnams kyi mthar rang sngags kyis bskor ba/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros mgon po'i thugs ka'i sa bon la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de las 'od 'phros yum bzhi'i thugs kar phog pas bskul zhing mgon po gtso 'khor lnga'i thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros phrin las thams cad thogs pa med par sgrub par gyur bar bsam la/

oṃ ma hā kā lā kā lā bi kā la rā tri ta ḍoṃ bhi nī tsaṇḍa lī rākṣa sī siṅga li' de wī hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa nus thang bzla/ thun mthar gtor ma la dgra bgegs 'gugs stim dbye bsgral sha khrag tu byin gyis brlabs la gong gi gtor sngags kyis phul nas/ hūm̐ */ 'jigs pa'i gzugs 'chang lha chen gdong bzhi pa// yum chen bzhi dang bshan pa dregs pa'i 'khor// ma lus 'dir gshegs sman raka gtor ma dang*// rdo rje gri gug ral gri mdung thung 'bar// mi rus phreng ba myos byed bum par bcas// rta g.yag lug nag mthing nag cod pan g.yo// sna tshogs 'dod dgu'i longs spyod drag po'i rdzas// mkha' khyab ye shes chen por byin brlabs pas// lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po'i thugs dam bskang*// yum chen sring mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang*// 'khor gyi dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*// hūm̐ */ lha chen drag po 'khor bcas la| |dam rdzas sman raka gtor mar bcas// bdud rtsir byin brlabs 'bul lags kyi// bzhes shig snoms shig tshim mdzod la// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang*// dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe srings// rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las sgrubs// dus la bab bo sa ma ya// zhes gtor ma do nub bsngos la nang zhogs snga bar 'bul/ nang zhogs bsngos na do nub 'bul ba lugs 'di pa'i khyad chos yin no| |rjes su shis brjod bya'o/ /de ltar dpal gdong bzhi pa'i gtor 'bul bsnyen sgrub shin tu bsdus pa 'di'ang*/ 'on rin chen brag gi bla ma dge slong lha mo dkon mchog lhun grub kyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa chos skyong 'di la nges pa cung zad rnyed pa dharma kīrtis rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ//
